1.text: With Voice Flow, you can speak your thoughts naturally and have them transcribed directly into whatever application you are using.
Every dictation is saved securely in your private workspace, where you can search, copy, or review past recordings anytime.
Next, let's explore your live productivity insights and speaking speed!

2.text: Step two is your live Insights dashboard.

Right here, you can track your real-time speaking speed in Words Per Minute, see exactly how much typing time you save compared to forty words per minute typing, and monitor your daily dictation streaks.
You can also review which desktop applications you dictate into most across seven days, thirty days, or all time.
Next, let's check out your personal dictionary!

3.text: Step three is your Personal Dictionary.
Add specialized jargon, product names, acronyms, or unique shortcuts right here.
Crucially, your Dictionary works seamlessly whether Voice Polishing is turned ON or completely turned OFF, guaranteeing zero misspellings and instant phonetic replacement every single time you speak.
Next, let's explore AI writing styles and voice commands!

4.text: Step four gives you customizable AI Styles and real-time Voice Commands.

When Voice Polishing is turned ON, the AI analyzes your entire sentence context and transforms your dictation into tailored tones, like Concise, Work Messages, Professional Email, or Developer formatting.
You can also speak voice commands naturally, such as 'bullet point this' or 'make it formal', and Voice Flow executes them on the fly.
Next, let's explore your AI models and providers!

5.text: Step five puts you in full control of your AI speech and polishing engines.
You can run completely offline with total privacy, or connect cloud API keys.
For speech recognition, we highly recommend the Nemotron speech model for blazing speed and accuracy.
For voice polishing, we recommend S1-mini by Superwhisper, which delivers high-precision grammar refinement with a lightweight local footprint.
If you prefer cloud APIs like Deepgram, Groq, or OpenAI, you can easily plug in your keys anytime.
Next, let's see how to dictate everywhere across Windows!

6.text: Finally, Voice Flow works seamlessly across your entire Windows computer.
Whenever you are replying to an email, drafting a document in Word, or chatting in Slack, simply hold your Middle Mouse Click or press Control plus Windows and start speaking.
Voice Flow automatically types and polishes your words directly into the active field in real time, with zero copy-pasting.
You are now ready to speak at the speed of thought.

6_mac.text: Finally, Voice Flow works seamlessly across your Mac.
Whenever you are replying to an email, drafting a document in Word, or chatting in Slack, simply press Command plus Option and start speaking.
Voice Flow automatically types and polishes your words directly into the active field in real time, with zero copy-pasting.
You are now ready to speak at the speed of thought.
